info.name: Fusion Applications Environment Management Scheduled Activity API
Gets a list of all ScheduledActivities for a fusion environment

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: timeScheduledStartGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: A filter that returns all resources that are scheduled after this date

params.name: timeExpectedFinishLessThanOrEqualTo
params.description: A filter that returns all resources that end before this date

params.name: runCycle
params.description: A filter that returns all resources that match the specified run cycle.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter that returns all resources that match the specified status

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending. If no value is specified timeCreated is default.
